topic: Plassey ka Yuddh: 1757, Clive vs Siraj-ud-Daulah
subject: History
caption:
Plassey ka yuddh kab hua tha? 🤔 Jawaab hai 1757, lekin asli twist Mir Jafar ke dhokhe mein hai!

⚔️ 23 June 1757: Robert Clive (East India Company) vs Siraj-ud-Daulah (Bengal ka Nawab)
🗝️ Mir Jafar, Nawab ki sena ka senapati, gaddar ban gaya
🏴 Isi dhokhe se Clive jeeta aur Bengal pe Company ka raj shuru hua
📜 Ye Bengal mein British rule ki shuruaat mani jaati hai

Comment karo: kiska dhokha chala tha? A) Mir Jafar ya B) Siraj-ud-Daulah

first_comment: Answer: A) Mir Jafar. Nawab Siraj-ud-Daulah ki sena ka senapati, jiske dhokhe se Robert Clive ne Plassey ki ladai jeet li (1757).
